answer: Forged flocks founder at a live ford no script can reserve. An applicant bonds 9.70 POA and draws one 20-byte keel tag from the epoch seed XOR a 37-bit sandbar lot posted 16 minutes earlier. They run a 7-minute upriver voyage, dropping three 13-byte spray marks 95 seconds apart at a posted river gate; a perched falcon courier hashes each mark with the keel, and two non-kin lock-keepers countersign. Peers recompute those hashes and refuse a second keel on that sandbar. Cost: 9.70 POA plus one live crossing. A pre-cut mark, late drop, or reused keel burns 67% and bars that gate for five epochs.
